description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to a med the International Telecommunications Operators Levy (Imposition) Regulations No. 01 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette content involves the amendment of regulations under the Finance Act, No. 11 of 2004, specifically modifying the International Telecommunications Operators Levy regulations. It contains detailed regulatory changes to levy rates and charges for international telecommunications operations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory framework modifications, not government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
